uncited: *   **Inputs:** Spatial coordinates $x \in \mathbb{R}^3$, viewing direction $d \in \mathbb{R}^3$, projected color mean $\bar{c}_p(x, k)$, and projected color variance $Var(c_p(x, k))$ at frame $k$.
For a 3D point $x$ at frame $k$, the set of projected colors $c_p(x, k)$ is derived from all training cameras $M$.
**Precompute Projections:** For each 3D point $x$ sampled during training and each frame $k$, project $x$ into the image plane of every camera $cam \in M$ using $P_{cam}$.
**Sample Colors:** Retrieve the pixel colors $C_{k, cam}$ at the projected coordinates.
**Compute Statistics:** Calculate the mean $\bar{c}_p(x, k)$ and variance $Var(c_p(x, k))$ of the collected colors.
**Model Forward Pass:** Construct the input vector $[x, d, \bar{c}_p(x, k), Var(c_p(x, k))]$.
*   **Color Invariance Assumption:** Projected colors are not perfectly invariant due to reflections, lighting changes, and occlusions.
